description: This file defines the AccountTransferRepository interface, which extends JpaRepository and JpaSpecificationExecutor to manage AccountTransferTransaction entities. It includes custom query methods for retrieving transfer transactions based on loan account IDs and transaction IDs, indicating it serves as a data access layer component related to account transfers within the application.

classes.name: AccountTransferRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for AccountTransferTransaction entities, providing methods to query account transfer transactions with custom filters.

methods.name: findByFromLoanId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of account transfer transactions originating from a specific loan account ID with the not-reversed filter.

methods.name: findAllByLoanId
methods.description: Retrieves all account transfer transactions related to a specific loan account ID, from or to, that are not reversed, ordered by transaction ID descending.

methods.name: findByToLoanTransactionId
methods.description: Fetches the account transfer transaction associated with a specific 'to' loan transaction ID, provided it is not reversed.

methods.name: findByFromLoanTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of account transfer transactions associated with a collection of 'from' loan transaction IDs, with the not-reversed filter.

calls: select att from AccountTransferTransaction att where att.accountTransferDetails.fromLoanAccount.id= :accountNumber and att.reversed=false

select att from AccountTransferTransaction att where (att.accountTransferDetails.fromLoanAccount.id= :accountNumber or att.accountTransferDetails.toLoanAccount.id=:accountNumber) and att.reversed=false order by att.id desc
select att from AccountTransferTransaction att where att.toLoanTransaction.id= :loanTransactionId and att.reversed=false
select att from AccountTransferTransaction att where att.fromLoanTransaction.id IN :loanTransactions and att.reversed=false
